user.description: Sets up Israel Transit and builds a local copy of the Ministry of Transport timetable, which downloads about 90 MB once. You then add your stops one by one.

abort.already_configured: Israel Transit is already set up. Add stops with the "Add stop" button on its page.

user.title: Find a stop
user.description: Search by stop name, city and street, or by the code printed on the stop sign. Words combine, so "Kfar Saba Weizmann" narrows to that street.

settings.title: Stop settings
settings.description:
{stop}

Choose which lines get their own sensors. Leave empty to track the stop as a whole.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh. Real-time data comes from a free community service, so please keep this at 60 seconds or more.
data_description.rail_destination: Only for railway stations. Israel Railways reports departure delays per route, so a destination is needed to show live train times instead of the timetable.

reconfigure.title: Stop settings
reconfigure.description:
{stop}

Choose which lines get their own sensors. Leave empty to track the stop as a whole.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh. Real-time data comes from a free community service, so please keep this at 60 seconds or more.
data_description.rail_destination: Only for railway stations. Israel Railways reports departure delays per route, so a destination is needed to show live train times instead of the timetable.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the local timetable index.

abort.already_configured: This stop is already set up.
abort.index_unavailable: The timetable index could not be built, so there are no stops to search: {error}

progress.building_index: Building the local timetable from the Ministry of Transport feed. This downloads about 90 MB and runs once.

get_arrivals.name: Get arrivals
get_arrivals.description: Returns the upcoming arrivals at a stop, for use in scripts, templates and automations.

stop_code.name: Stop code
stop_code.description: The Ministry of Transport stop code printed on the stop sign.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: Only return these line numbers. Leave empty for all lines.

rail_destination.name: Train destination
rail_destination.description: Israel Railways destination station ID, for live train departures.

refresh_stop.name: Refresh stop
refresh_stop.description: Fetches a stop's arrivals now instead of waiting for its next update.

search_stops.name: Search stops
search_stops.description: Searches the Ministry of Transport stops by name, city, street or code.

query.name: Search
query.description: Words to search for, or a stop code.

rebuild_timetable.name: Rebuild timetable
rebuild_timetable.description: Downloads the Ministry of Transport timetable again and rebuilds the local copy. Takes a few minutes and about 90 MB.

stop_unavailable.message: Could not read arrivals for stop {stop_code}: {error}

no_stop_readable.message: None of the configured stops could be read. Retrying.

invalid_target.message: The target is not an Israel Transit stop that is set up.

index_unavailable.message: The local timetable is not built yet. Try again once it is.

rebuild_in_progress.message: The timetable is already being rebuilt.

gtfs_index_failed.title: The Israeli public transport timetable could not be downloaded

confirm.title: Rebuild the timetable

progress.rebuilding: Downloading and indexing the Ministry of Transport timetable. This can take a few minutes.

error.rebuild_failed: The rebuild failed again. Check the network connection and free disk space, then try again.
error.rebuild_in_progress: A rebuild is already running. Wait for it to finish.

realtime_unavailable.title: Real-time arrivals are unavailable
realtime_unavailable.description:
None of your bus stops has had real-time data for over half an hour, so their times come from the timetable. The real-time service (curlbus) may be down. This clears by itself once it answers again.

The last error was: {error}

arrival.name: Line arrives at a stop
arrival.description: Triggers when a vehicle reaches a stop, or a set time before or after it does. Follows the live time as it changes, and fires once per trip.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: How long before or after the arrival to trigger. Zero triggers at the arrival itself.

offset_type.name: Before or after
offset_type.description: Whether the offset is before the arrival or after it.

delay.name: Vehicle delayed
delay.description: Triggers once per trip when a vehicle is reported late by at least the given number of minutes. Delays are reported for trains with a destination set.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line or train number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

min_delay.name: Minimum delay
min_delay.description: Trigger once the delay reaches this many minutes.

is_arriving_within.name: Vehicle arriving within
is_arriving_within.description: Tests if a vehicle, of one line or any, is due at the stop within the given number of minutes.

line.name: Line
line.description: Only this line number. Leave empty for every line at the stop.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How soon the vehicle has to be due.

is_realtime_available.name: Real-time is available
is_realtime_available.description: Tests if the stop's times are live rather than from the timetable.
